key_safety.text: Most common adverse reactions (>35% of subjects) were fatigue, anemia, nausea, headache, and dysgeusia. Anemia was more frequent with VICTRELIS combination (50% vs 30% in treatment-naive; 45% vs 20% in treatment failures); dose modifications due to anemia occurred twice as often (26% vs 13%).
